basic_info.device_description: The ADS8568 is a 16-bit, 8-channel simultaneous sampling successive approximation register (SAR) analog-to-digital converter (ADC). It offers a maximum data rate of 510 kSPS in parallel mode and 400 kSPS in serial mode per channel. The device features excellent AC performance with 91.5 dB SNR and -94 dB THD, and supports input voltage ranges up to ±12 V using a programmable internal reference. Designed for industrial applications, the ADS8568 operates over an extended temperature range of -40°C to +125°C and is available in 64-pin VQFN and LQFP packages.
